rescued_events.title: Roman Galleries of Lisbon Reopening Visit
rescued_events.description: The Roman Galleries of Rua da Prata in Lisbon will reopen for visitor tours in September 2026 after being closed in April. This rare event allows visitors to explore the underground Roman water reservoirs and archaeological remains beneath downtown Lisbon, with tickets selling out quickly.

ai_review.reason: The page informs about the reopening of the Roman Galleries of Rua da Prata in Lisbon in September 2026 as a special occasion when visitors can tour the archaeological site, which is normally closed due to water levels. It represents a scheduled reopening event for a guided visit to this heritage site.

rescued_events.title: Official Portrait of President Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa by Artist Vhils Exhibition
rescued_events.description: The official portrait of President Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa, a unique work created by artist Vhils using newspapers from the past 10 years, was unveiled on March 4, 2026, and is on display at the Museum of the Presidency of the Republic in Lisbon. The exhibition shows a contemporary approach to the presidential portrait and is open to the public during museum hours.
